# Set Up

```{r Set Up, include = T}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(lme4)
library(posterior)

# Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(123)
```

```{r Read Data, include = T}
ctads_ema_data = read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HannahEveMarshall/ctads_sleep_anhedonia/main/data/public_data.csv")
```

# Prepare Data

```{r Select Variables, include = T}
ctads_ema_data = ctads_ema_data %>% 
  select(participant_id,
         group,
         ema_day,
         prompt_number,
         time,
         sleep_disturb,
         sleep_amount,
         c_anhed_rev,
         a_anhed_rev,
         tiredness,
         age_m,
         sex,
         race,
         ethn,
         income)

# Ensure group is a factor variable
ctads_ema_data$group = factor(ctads_ema_data$group)
```

```{r Reverse Code Variables, include = T}
ctads_ema_data = ctads_ema_data %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(c_anhed = 100 - c_anhed_rev,
         a_anhed = 100 - a_anhed_rev)
```

```{r Person-Mean Center Variables, include = T}
ctads_ema_data = ctads_ema_data %>% 
  # Group by participant
  group_by(participant_id) %>% 
  # Compute variable means
  mutate(sleep_disturb_m = mean(sleep_disturb,
                                na.rm = T),
         c_anhed_m = mean(c_anhed,
                          na.rm = T),
         a_anhed_m = mean(a_anhed,
                          na.rm = T),
         sleep_amount_m = mean(sleep_amount,
                               na.rm = T),
         tiredness_m = mean(tiredness,
                            na.rm = T)) %>%  
  ungroup()

# Person-mean center variables
ctads_ema_data = ctads_ema_data %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(sleep_disturb_pc = sleep_disturb - sleep_disturb_m,
         c_anhed_pc = c_anhed - c_anhed_m,
         a_anhed_pc = a_anhed - a_anhed_m,
         sleep_amount_pc = sleep_amount - sleep_amount_m,
         tiredness_pc = tiredness - tiredness_m) %>% 
  ungroup()
```

```{r Within-Day Sleep Variable Propagation, include = T}
# Carry forward sleep reports to create complete rows
ctads_ema_data = ctads_ema_data %>%
  arrange(participant_id, 
          ema_day, 
          prompt_number) %>%
  group_by(participant_id, 
           ema_day) %>%
  # Use the earliest non-missing sleep report for each variable
  mutate(sleep_disturb = first(sleep_disturb[!is.na(sleep_disturb)],
                                     default = NA_real_),
         sleep_amount = first(sleep_amount[!is.na(sleep_amount)],
                                    default = NA_real_)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

# Create Function for Viewing Posterior Probabilities

```{r Create Function for Viewing Posterior Probabilities, include = T}
posterior_summary = function(fit) {
  post = as.data.frame(brms::posterior_samples(fit))
  fe = brms::fixef(fit)
  
  # Convert names of fixed effects to posterior column names
  post_names = paste0("b_", 
                      rownames(fe))
  
  # Compute posterior probabilities
  P_gt_0 = sapply(post_names, 
                  function(b) mean(post[[b]] > 0))
  P_lt_0 = sapply(post_names, 
                  function(b) mean(post[[b]] < 0))
  
  # Combine into one table
  out = cbind(fe, 
              P_lt_0,
              P_gt_0)
  
  # Round outputs to 3 decimal places
  out = round(out, 3)
  
  return(out)
}
```

# Analyses for Which Results Are Reported in the Main Paper

## Analyses With MDD as the Refeerence Group

```{r Set MDD as the Reference Group, include = T}
ctads_ema_data$group = relevel(ctads_ema_data$group, 
                               ref = "1")
```

### Preregistered Analyses 

#### Anticipatory Anhedonia as a Function of the Sleep Disturbances × Time of Day × Group Interaction (Full Model Results in Table S3)

```{r Anticipatory Anhedonia Sleep Disturbances Model, include = T, warning = F, message = F}
aa_sdis_model = brm(formula = a_anhed_pc ~ sleep_disturb_pc * time * group +
                      (1 + time * sleep_disturb_pc | participant_id) + 
                      (1 | participant_id:ema_day),
                    data = ctads_ema_data,
                    chains = 4, 
                    cores = 4, 
                    iter = 4000,
                    seed = 123,
                    refresh = 0)

summary(aa_sdis_model)
posterior_summary(aa_sdis_model)
```

#### Consummatory Anhedonia as a Function of the Sleep Disturbances × Time of Day × Group Interaction (Full Model Results in Table S4)

### Intraclass Correlation Coefficients

```{r Separate MDD and HV Data, include = T}
mdd_ctads_ema_data = ctads_ema_data %>% 
  filter(group == 1)

hc_ctads_ema_data = ctads_ema_data %>% 
  filter(group == 0)
```

```{r Create a Function for Computing ICCs, include = T}
compute_icc = function(data, 
                       measure) {
  
  model = lmer(as.formula(paste(measure, "~ 1 + (1 | participant_id)")),
               data = data,
               REML = T)
  
  vc = as.data.frame(VarCorr(model))
  var_between = vc$vcov[vc$grp == "participant_id"]
  var_within = vc$vcov[vc$grp == "Residual"]
  ICC = var_between / (var_between + var_within)
  
  return(ICC)
}
```

```{r Sleep Disturbances ICC for MDD, include = T}
compute_icc(data = mdd_ctads_ema_data,
            measure = "sleep_disturb")
```

## Table S2: Within-Person and Between-Person Posterior Correlations Between Variables

```{r Create a Function for Savage-Dickey BF10 Calculations for LKJ(1) Correlations, include = T}
# Create a function for Savage-Dickey BF10 calculations for LKJ(1) correlations to use after extracting posterior correlations
BF10_from_draws = function(x) {
  
  # Compute posterior KDE
  d = density(x,
              from = -1,
              to = 1,
              n = 100000,
              bw = "SJ")
  
  # Identify posterior density at rho = 0
  post_at_0 = approx(d$x,
                     d$y,
                     xout = 0,
                     rule = 2)$y
  
  # Identify LKJ(1) prior density at rho = 0
  prior_at_0 = 0.5
  
  # If density at 0 is numerically zero, use the smallest positive density in the KDE
  if (post_at_0 <= 0) {
    post_at_0 = min(d$y[d$y > 0])
  }
  
  # Compute Savage-Dickey BF10
  BF10 = prior_at_0 / post_at_0
  
  BF10
}
```

```{r MDD Posterior Correlations Between Anticipatory and Consummatory Anhedonia, include = T, warning = F, message = F}
mdd_ca_aa_cor_model = brm(brmsformula(mvbind(c_anhed, a_anhed) ~ 1 + (1 | p | participant_id),
                                      set_rescor(T)),
                          data = mdd_ctads_ema_data,
                          chains = 4, 
                          cores = 4,
                          iter = 4000,
                          family = gaussian(),
                          seed = 123)

mdd_ca_aa_draws = as_draws_df(mdd_ca_aa_cor_model)

mdd_ca_aa_within_r = mdd_ca_aa_draws$rescor__canhed__aanhed

mdd_ca_aa_between_r = mdd_ca_aa_draws$cor_participant_id__canhed_Intercept__aanhed_Intercept

# Posterior summaries
mdd_ca_aa_within_summary = data.frame(effect = "Within-person",
                                      r = mean(mdd_ca_aa_within_r),
                                      CrI_low = quantile(mdd_ca_aa_within_r, 0.025),
                                      CrI_high = quantile(mdd_ca_aa_within_r, 0.975))

mdd_ca_aa_between_summary = data.frame(effect = "Between-person",
                                       r = mean(mdd_ca_aa_between_r),
                                       CrI_low = quantile(mdd_ca_aa_between_r, 0.025),
                                       CrI_high = quantile(mdd_ca_aa_between_r, 0.975))

cor_summary = bind_rows(mdd_ca_aa_within_summary, 
                        mdd_ca_aa_between_summary)

cor_summary
```

```{r BF10 for MDD Posterior Correlations Between Anticipatory and Consummatory Anhedonia, include = T}
data.frame(Effect = c("Within-person", 
                      "Between-person"),
           BF10 = c(BF10_from_draws(mdd_ca_aa_within_r), 
                    BF10_from_draws(mdd_ca_aa_between_r)))
```

```{r HV Posterior Correlations Between Consummatory and Anticipatory Anhedonia, include = T, warning = F, message = F}
                                         r = mean(hv_sdis_sdur_within_r),
                                         CrI_low = quantile(hv_sdis_sdur_within_r, 0.025),
                                         CrI_high = quantile(hv_sdis_sdur_within_r, 0.975))

hv_sdis_sdur_between_summary = data.frame(effect = "Between-person",
                                          r = mean(hv_sdis_sdur_between_r),
                                          CrI_low = quantile(hv_sdis_sdur_between_r, 0.025),
                                          CrI_high = quantile(hv_sdis_sdur_between_r, 0.975))

cor_summary = bind_rows(hv_sdis_sdur_within_summary, 
                        hv_sdis_sdur_between_summary)

cor_summary
```

```{r BF10 for HV Posterior Correlations Between Consummatory and Anticipatory Anhedonia, include = T}
data.frame(Effect = c("Within-person", 
                      "Between-person"),
           BF10 = c(BF10_from_draws(hv_sdis_sdur_within_r), 
                    BF10_from_draws(hv_sdis_sdur_between_r)))
```
